messages.text:
Hello HeliumDeploy Support,

I’m following up again regarding my replacement miner for order
Shop····, originally placed on October 8, 2026, with an expected
shipping date of October 15.

Today is November 10, nearly four weeks after the original expected
shipping date, and I still have not received shipping confirmation or
tracking information for my replacement Thor P2.

On October 30, I contacted Sarah, your AI support representative, who
confirmed that the replacement was in stock and awaiting internal approval.
She indicated that approval was expected that morning and that shipping
would occur within two business days afterward.

I followed up again on November 4, and on (address hidden), Sarah advised that
approval was still pending and that the replacement would ship within two
business days once approved.

I genuinely appreciate your willingness to arrange the replacement and the
discount you previously offered. This is my fourth miner purchased from
HeliumDeploy, and I’ve been very happy with your products.

However, given the time that has passed since my original order and the
repeated assurances regarding shipping, I would appreciate a clear
explanation of what is causing the delay and a realistic shipping date.

I’m eager to get my mining equipment operational and would appreciate your
assistance in getting this resolved.

Thank you, and I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Robert H.
Handed to the team · Asked repeatedly since Oct 30 (flagged Oct 30, Nov 4, Nov 6, Nov 9), still unapp

Hi Robert,

You're owed a straight answer. You ordered on October 8, the QX1 was due to ship on October 15, and you accepted the free Thor P2 swap on October 29. Since then we've told you more than once that approval was coming, and it hasn't come. I'm sorry for that.

Here is what's causing the delay. The Thor P2 costs more than the $248 you paid for the QX1. We offered you the swap at no extra charge, but covering that difference needs a sign-off from a senior member of the team. I can't give that sign-off myself, and nobody has given it yet. Nothing is wrong on your side, and there is no stock problem. The Thor P2 is on the shelf at our US warehouse right now.

The free swap you accepted still stands. You won't be asked to pay anything for it.

I've sent your order back to the team, and this time the request is just that one sign-off. The team is back at 10am ET today. As soon as they approve it, I'll make the swap on your order myself. The Thor P2 then ships within 2 business days, and the tracking comes to this email address. I'd rather not give you another date until that approval is actually done.

Thank you for sticking with us through four orders. This isn't how a returning customer should be treated.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
